subject: Shortfall alert — microcommit calendar & runway snapshot
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Trent <sophie.trent@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Shortfall alert — microcommit calendar & runway snapshot

Team,

Quick signal — Q4 runway snapshot attached shows a shortfall vs. commit targets driven by slower-than-expected movement in mid-market and three late-stage ACME line items. High level: at current weighted coverage we land ~32% below the bookings target for the month unless we surface additional microcommits or move a few higher-confidence opportunities forward.

Attachments: runway_snapshot_q4.xlsx (summary + by-owner heatmap), microcommit_heatmap.pdf (visual), acme_commit_list.csv (filtered).

Asks:
- Owners (Marcus, Lauren): update stage and commit status for opportunities assigned to you by EOD today (include explicit commit amounts and probability).
- Finance (Naomi): we need a lock time — what is the latest we can accept revisions before you close the forecast?
- If any external negotiation blockers remain (Acme legal/pricing/product), please call them out so we can escalate.

I'll compile a microcommit calendar and propose a 30-min commit lock call if there's material movement. Sophie — looping you so Acme knows we're aiming to close this week; if there are outstanding items on your side please flag.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runway_snapshot_q4.xlsx; microcommit_heatmap.pdf; acme_commit_list.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shortfall alert — microcommit calendar & runway snapshot

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 9:12 AM Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Quick signal — Q4 runway snapshot attached shows a shortfall vs. commit targets...

Thanks Aditya — got it. I'm pulling the owner-level list now and will push stage updates for the 8 deals that look movable. Summary of my initial read (details in attached acme_commit_list.csv):

- 5 deals I own: three have updated technical validation this week and I can move them to Commit (total upside $420k) if we get a final pricing confirmation from Acme by EOD.
- 2 deals need small SOW adjustments (legal) — target decision 11/26; low probability but can surface as conditional commits.
- 1 flagged deal is unlikely to close this month and I propose we push to Jan rather than overpromise.

I'll update HubSpot and the CSV with explicit commit amounts and my confidence % by 15:30 PT. If helpful, I'll also add a short note per-row with the next blocking step.

—Marcus
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_commit_list.csv

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shortfall alert — microcommit calendar & runway snapshot

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 10:05 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Aditya — got it. I'm pulling the owner-level list now and will push stage updates...

Quick update from my side: I've moved 5 inbound opportunities into Commit and adjusted ARR on two that were overstated.
- Marked two opportunities as "needs product sign-off" (internal demo scheduled 11/26 10am PT).
- Flagged ACME-889 as "pricing review" — awaiting Sophie confirmation on final discount band.

I booked a 30-min microcommit slot for tomorrow 11/26 at 10:30am PT to run a rapid lock with Finance and any required stakeholders. Agenda: final commit tallies, blockers, and confirm forecast lock time.

Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager, North America
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Trent <sophie.trent@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shortfall alert — microcommit calendar & runway snapshot

Thanks for the flags — helpful. A couple of finance constraints to call out before the lock:

- Forecast lock window: we will accept final commit revisions until 17:00 PT today (11/25). After that I will close the Q4 numbers and share the locked forecast at 17:30 PT.
- Credit/discount note: any additional discount over 20% needs executive approval and will slow recognition; please surface any asks now so we can expedite.
- If ACME does not sign by the end of the week, Finance prefers shifting the smaller $85k item to Jan rather than inflating this month's numbers.

Sophie — can you confirm whether ACME can provide final sign-off on ACME-889 pricing by EOD or if we should plan for the Jan fallback?

I'll reconcile Marcus' CSV once he pushes updates and will publish the locked numbers to the shared Drive link.

—Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference

Quoted earlier messages preserved above.
